tried_1h.change: colour-keyed and mirrored copies of known source rows four pixels at a time (SIMD4 compare and select)
tried_1h.review: correct, no counterexample; the model test was strengthened from it (patterned background, known bits over unknown pixels, offsets derived from the row stride)
tried_1h.result: render thread 21.9 ms per tick (A1: 22.0/22.3): no measurable gain; the copy loop fell only from 34% to 32% of the render thread's samples: the render thread is bound by memory traffic (a 1.75 MB back buffer streamed several times per tick), not arithmetic. Reverted; the copy-model test kept as a regression test; the tried version kept in the session scratchpad (tried-1h).

profile_before: render thread (rt1h-profile): copy loop 31.7%, memcpy 31.3%, channel swap 9.8%, ioctl 6.5%, madvise 2.9%; crop allocated Data(count:) (calloc, zero-filled 1.75 MB) for every present, then freed it (pages returned with madvise), so each present also paid page faults and zero-filling in the kernel
change: OriginalMacDisplayBackend.FramePool keeps the buffers of the last three crops; crop takes the oldest when it has the right size and overwrites it in place (copy-on-write makes a fresh copy if anything still holds it), and every byte of the crop is written either way. Used by every crop (the four render-thread present paths and the synchronous framebuffer path).
